neutral_facts.correct_value: A summary of the fee allegations without Bar Council findings, referring only to roles.

neutral_facts.reason: It describes the Bar Council proceedings, which are post-incident forum proceedings, and states withdrawal 'without sufficient cause' and no refund. Those are not the facts of the case and are not stated in the judgment.

number_of_offences.reason: Count is debatable; the Article 215 action was also imposed. 0 upheld is correct.
